observations.note: The judge graded the gap list MET from grep output alone and never opened a spec file, although the intent requires opening what a search finds.
The judge says it only spot-checked the gap list and did not repeat every search the note reports, which the intent explicitly requires.
Four near-identical greps for the same terms were run with small variations and added little, ending in an 11-character result.
Criteria 1-4, 7 and 8 are said to rest on engine check findings, but the turns do not show those findings quoted, so the covered-id and owner-decision grades may be unverified.
